about: shard-open-plots's land settings (meta WORKTREE-LAND-STANDARD WL4; keys in scripts/land.mjs). shard-open-plots is public, so its hosted Actions run: land waits for the exact plan/<slug> SHA's `ci` push run (every job in that run, Ring 2 play included; ring-2-prepare.yml is nightly and dispatch only, not a land gate). pnpm's frozen install after a dependency rebase; no TS10 flaky quarantine.
